_comment: Which module owns a migration of the boot ladder (boot/migrationLadder.js): name -> module id, for every name of modules/firstParty/order.json "migrations" and of boot/bootMigrations.js NL_TRANSLATIONS whose file scripts/module-map.json gives to a module. The ladder skips such a name silently while its module is not here, also when the module is not installed at all and there is neither a file nor a map to ask. boot/migrationLadder.test.js holds this record equal to the map; add a line when a module takes over a migration.
